name: army_ant_carpet
description: Army-ant swarm front, side view at ground level, moving right: a low dense living carpet of overlapping red-brown Eciton workers (dark #5a2a18 interior with #3a160c speckle), legs and elbowed antennae poking up along a ragged top edge, three pale-headed soldiers riding the top. The right end (x +470..+600) is the ragged leading edge thinning to a few scouts; the left end is cut straight and opaque for tiling. Bottom-centre anchor, x -600..600, y -220..0. Tiles every 1080 (each tile drawn over the one to its left).
